script_text: Listen: a shadow looms, but Mercury is not retrograde. September 10, 2026: Mercury is direct in Leo before its October 29 Sagittarius reversal. Mercury retrograde is the apparent backward journey as Earth passes Mercury; communication, travel, contracts, and technology repeat for review. Mercury rules Gemini and Virgo; air is its element. During the retrograde, Mercury will square Uranus and sextile Chiron at wide orbs, making messages vague, delayed, or disruptive. For every sign, check contracts and bills; in your 7th House, renegotiate commitments, and in your 10th House, review work plans and finances. In love, your 5th House favors honest conversation over an impulsive confession. The Retrograde exposes karmic North Node wounds, revealing Chiron's fear of being misunderstood. What you avoid saying returns until healed. Put agreements in writing, keep backups, and wait 48 hours before sending a message. Comment your sign and tell me which house Mercury activates.
